title: The carnival season ends in Palatka, Florida, then vaudeville
summary: The carnival closed in Palatka, Florida in about November 1924 and Young moved into vaudeville.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: We got on that show, and we went everywhere. We went traveling around. The show closed in Palatka, Florida.
I don't exactly know how to spell it right.
Palatka, Florida is where the first tour you were on with the Willis Young band ended. Is that right?
No, that's where the show closed. The carnival.
When was that when that first closed?
So April to November you were with the show. The carnival.
And then in November you got into vaudeville.
Yeah. But he got back out of it, though.
